games.name: Untitled Upgrade Tree
games.desc:
Welcome to Untitled Upgrade Tree (UUT)!

UUT is an upgrade tree incremental game featuring multiple reset layers, currently 7. Each reset grants powerful boosts, so you won’t need to grind for hours just to get back to where you were. Instead, resets help you progress faster.

An upgrade tree incremental is a progression system where players earn resources and spend them on interconnected upgrades arranged in a tree. Each upgrade increases production, unlocks new mechanics, or enhances previous upgrades, leading to exponential growth over time.

The game already offers over 12 hours of content, with the long-term goal of reaching over 20 hours of gameplay and upgrades

⚠️This game isn't very epilepsy-friendly (play at your own risk)
⚠️UUT is made for fans of incremental games and upgrade trees and is kinda beginner-friendly
supports PC, Mobile, and Console

🙏The game is highly inspired by Everything Upgrade Tree (EUT) & Grass Cutting Incremental (GCI)
